content.short: Bitci is a platform for trading tokens of national football teams.
content.description: National competitions are a key part of football, and Bitci offers a platform for national teams to create and deploy their own fan tokens. It doubles as a crypto trading platform where these tokens can be bought and sold. The national teams of Turkey, Brazil, and Spain have fan tokens available on Bitci, reflecting how football supporters engage with digital assets through this platform. These tokens are issued to fans and traded within Bitci's platform, contributing to the evolving landscape of football's digital asset ecosystem.
